backend_policy: Python-only for repository-generated quantitative figures unless the manuscript team explicitly elects R before figure production.

journal_export_contract.font_policy: Arial/Helvetica preferred with DejaVu Sans fallback; SVG text remains editable and PDF uses TrueType fonts.
journal_export_contract.error_bar_policy: Show mean with SEM when replicate-level data are available; otherwise mark error bars as not estimable in source data and QA.
journal_export_contract.image_integrity_policy: Quantitative panels are deterministic from source data. Scene-image panels may apply only documented ValidScene masking and registered coordinate transforms with source hashes and QA outputs.

figures.core_conclusion: The final analysis sample and scene design are traceable by participant group, recruitment batch, WWR, complexity, and presentation order.
figures.review_risk: Must not hide low-experience supplementation or imbalance; report before/after counts explicitly.
figures.statistics_note: Counts and percentages; no inferential test is implied.
figures.image_integrity_note: All bars are direct counts from sample/design QC CSV files.

figures.core_conclusion: WWR and visual complexity effects on S1-S5 are evaluated as item-level outcomes rather than an unvalidated composite scale.
figures.review_risk: Avoid claiming a definitive WWR optimum from three levels; use planned-contrast language.
figures.statistics_note: Mean with SEM when group-level variability is available; planned contrast is exploratory trend evidence.
figures.image_integrity_note: No smoothing or interpolation beyond connecting observed WWR levels.

figures.manuscript_role: Eye-tracking dynamic search, window direction, and measurement validity
figures.core_conclusion: Eye-search dynamics and window-directed gaze are reported with independent eye-sample QC, AOI structure, and bounded exploratory pupil evidence.

panel_map.claim_role: Independent eye sample and threshold retention
Transition entropy, scanpath, and saccade rate by complexity
First window fixation and window-directed transitions
Exploratory scene-early pupil and blink measures

figures.review_risk: Do not mix AOI-row and scene-trial grains; pupil uses a scene-early reference and remains luminance-confounded and exploratory.
figures.statistics_note: Every panel identifies AOI or scene-trial grain, available n, and SEM or conditional-probability definition; model inference comes from canonical GEE tables.
figures.image_integrity_note: AOI geometry values are plotted directly from validation output.

figures.core_conclusion: EEG interpretations are bounded by synchronization QC and convergence with eye-tracking and questionnaire evidence.
figures.review_risk: Do not present EEG-only cognitive-load claims unless multimodal convergence and absolute-clock alignment QC support them; report scene/time disagreement as scale dependent.
figures.statistics_note: Scene-level and synchronized-timebin participant-clustered GEE are co-primary; temporal models use independent working correlation and robust sandwich SE.
figures.image_integrity_note: No temporal interpolation is plotted; 2-second features use identical absolute-time intervals.

figures.core_conclusion: Formal order/fatigue-proxy estimates and sensitivity analyses determine how strongly each manuscript claim can be stated.
figures.review_risk: Claim strength must be downgraded when sensitivity checks or modality convergence are incomplete.
figures.statistics_note: Participant-clustered GEE block/position estimates with 95% confidence intervals, WWR45 peak index, and categorical claim-strength scores.
figures.image_integrity_note: Claim scores are categorical encodings for visual audit only; manuscript wording uses the original labels.

figures.manuscript_role: Spatial distribution of QC-passed eye fixations across the six WWR × Complexity conditions
figures.core_conclusion: After 60% tracking QC and Block 2-to-Block 1 registration, fixation-event density can be compared on one common scene canvas for each of the six experimental conditions.
figures.review_risk: Do not pool Block 1 and Block 2 coordinates without registration; report registration QC, the 60% tracking threshold, and any fixation loss after warping.
figures.statistics_note: The primary plate is a per-condition normalized event-density visualization, not an inferential test. A duration-weighted sensitivity plate is exported separately.
figures.image_integrity_note: Block 2 coordinates are transformed to the Block 1 reference canvas; pixels outside confirmed ValidScene masks are rendered white. Source-image hashes and transform matrices are retained.
